q1.explanationZh: agree with sb.“同意某人的意见”，with 后面接人，如 agree with you；与 have the same opinion with sb. 意思相同。

q2.explanationZh: at work“在工作”，如 I’m at work.（我正在工作。）

q3.explanationZh: as long as“只要”，引导条件状语从句，从句常用一般现在时表示将来。

q4.explanationZh: all over“到处，遍及”，后面常接地点，如 all over the world，与 everywhere 意思相同。

q5.explanationZh: “在周末”可以说 at weekends（英式）或 on weekends（美式），weekends 用复数。

q6.explanationZh: a couple of“两个；几个”，后面接可数名词复数，如 a couple of years。

q7.explanationZh: all right 可表示同意“好吧，行了”，也可表示身体“好了”；注意是两个词，right 不是 rite。

q8.explanationZh: at the same time“同时”，same 前面要有定冠词 the。

q9.explanationZh: a kind of“一种；一类”；“各种各样的”是 all kinds of。

q10.explanationZh: at the end of“在……结束的时候；在……末尾”，如 at the end of August（8 月底）。

q11.explanationZh: all the way“一路上；一直”，如 run all the way here（一路跑来）。

q12.explanationZh: after all“终究；毕竟”，可放在句首或句末。

q13.explanationZh: at present“现在，目前”，与 now、for the time being 意思相同，句子常用现在时。

q14.explanationZh: and so on“等等”，用在列举的几项后面。

q15.explanationZh: apologize（英式也拼作 apologise）to sb. for sth.“为某事向某人道歉”：to 后接人，for 后接事；与 say sorry to sb. for sth. 意思相同。

q16.explanationZh: a lot of 和 lots of 都表示“许多”，后面既可接可数名词复数，也可接不可数名词。

q17.explanationZh: “在吃早/午/晚餐时”用介词 at，三餐名词前不加冠词：at breakfast、at lunch、at supper。

q18.explanationZh: at once“立刻；马上”，与 immediately、right now、right away 意思相同。

q19.explanationZh: “到达某地”：小地方用 arrive at，大地方（城市、国家）用 arrive in；与 get to/reach a place 意思相同。

q20.explanationZh: according to“按照；根据”，to 是介词，后面接名词或代词。

q21.explanationZh: at home“在家”，home 前不加冠词。

q22.explanationZh: a piece of 用来给不可数名词计数，如 a piece of paper / information。

q23.explanationZh: ask for“请求；寻求”，后面接想要得到的东西，如 ask for help。

q24.explanationZh: amusement park“游乐园”，amusement 以元音音素开头，前面用 an。

q25.explanationZh: at first 意为“起先；开始的时候”，at last 意为“最后；终于”，两者意思相反，常在同一句中对照使用。

q26.explanationZh: “有一点儿”= a bit，放在比较级 better 前面表示“稍微好一点”，后面没有名词，所以不用 of。

q27.explanationZh: “一副眼镜”= a pair of glasses；主语是 a pair，所以用 is。

q28.explanationZh: “到处”= all over，all over the district 意为“在整个地区”。

q29.explanationZh: “加上”= add…to…，把 sugar 放在 add 和 to 中间：add too much sugar to the cake；Don’t 后用动词原形 add。

q30.explanationZh: “至少”= at least，放在数量 one million tons 前面。

q31.explanationZh: 前面有 at first（开始时），后面用 at last（最后；终于）形成对照。

q32.explanationZh: “如同”= as…as，中间用形容词原级 heavy；否定句 not as/so…as 表示“不如……那么……”。

q34.explanationZh: “一……就……”= as soon as，放在句首要大写 As。

q35.explanationZh: “请求帮助”= ask for help，I’ll 后用动词原形。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “同意某人的意见”= agree with sb.，“你”作宾语用 you。

q37.sampleAnswer: Above all Susie is a good and tireless writer.
references: Above all Susie is a good and tireless writer.
Above all, Susie is a good and tireless writer.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: above all 放在句首，表示“最重要的是；总之”；“不知疲倦的”= tireless。

q38.sampleAnswer: The traffic in the countryside is not as convenient as that in the city.
references: The traffic in the countryside is not as convenient as that in the city.
The traffic in the countryside is not so convenient as that in the city.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: not as/so + 形容词原级 + as 表示“不如……那样……”；后面用 that 代替前面的 the traffic，避免重复。

q39.sampleAnswer: Miss Wu is our class teacher and our friend as well.
references: Miss Wu is our class teacher and our friend as well.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: as well 意为“也”，放在句末；也可以说 not only…but also…。

q40.sampleAnswer: This shop sells all kinds of watches from different countries.
references: This shop sells all kinds of watches from different countries.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “各种款式的”= all kinds of（a kind of 的复数用法），后面接名词复数 watches；主语 this shop 是第三人称单数，用 sells。

q41.sampleAnswer: You must apologise to her for having kept her waiting.
references: You must apologise to her for having kept her waiting.
You must apologize to her for having kept her waiting.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: apologize to her for…：to 后接人，for 后接原因；for 是介词，后接动名词 having kept her waiting。

q42.sampleAnswer: She spends her day doing housework, watching television, reading, and so on.
references: She spends her day doing housework, watching television, reading, and so on.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: spend time doing sth.“花时间做某事”，列举几件事后用 and so on 表示“等等”。

q43.sampleAnswer: More and more foreigners are living and working in Shanghai at present.
references: More and more foreigners are living and working in Shanghai at present.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “目前”= at present，说的是现在正在发生的事，用现在进行时 are living and working；“越来越多的”= more and more。

q44.sampleAnswer: According to the study, it is unhealthy to eat too much before you go to bed.
references: According to the study, it is unhealthy to eat too much before you go to bed.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “根据研究”= according to the study；“做某事是不健康的”用 it is unhealthy to do sth.。

q45.sampleAnswer: Although the World Expo was over, a lot of visitors still go to the China Pavilion to enjoy themselves and take photos.
references: Although the World Expo was over, a lot of visitors still go to the China Pavilion to enjoy themselves and take photos.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “很多游客”= a lot of visitors；although 引导让步状语从句，英语中不能再用 but。
